title: Seat a counting chamber in the microscope stage pocket, latch both stage clips, and lay the coverslip flat
instruction: Seat the counting chamber in the stage pocket, latch both stage clips over its shoulders, lay the coverslip flat across the central rails, and clear both grippers.
context: Every automated cell-viability and suspension-counting cycle in a self-driving microscopy workcell seats a precision double-grid glass counting chamber against the stage reference edges, latches both spring stage clips over the outer shoulders, and sets a rigid ground fused-quartz coverslip flat across the central H-moat rails to define the counting volume before optical imaging. Because the stage pocket's 95 N/m sprung datum plunger pushes an unheld 68 g chamber back out of the pocket before the clips engage, bracing the chamber in the pocket while latching both stage clips and laying the 36 g coverslip achieves repeatable registration.
setup: A fixed matte-black anodized microscope mechanical stage (300 x 430 x 16 mm, on 3 mm rubber corner feet, friction 0.04) sits on the station tabletop with a condenser aperture and V-funnelled datum pocket at (0.235, -0.045) m, a 28 g sprung brass front datum plunger (95 N/m return spring), and a front staging cradle at (0.235, -0.148) m. Two 32 g spring-loaded chrome stage clips pivot horizontally at (0.179, -0.077) m and (0.291, -0.077) m from 52 deg open (0.045 N m/rad opening springs) into 28 g sprung brass detent catches (45 N/m, 18 deg cam ramps) over the pocket's outer shoulders. A 68 g double-grid optical glass counting chamber (84 x 36 mm glass block with twin silvered counting platforms, 10 mm central coverslip support rails, 9 mm outer clip shoulders, and an offset +X/+Y 30 x 42 x 24 mm knurled handling grip) starts 34 mm outside the pocket at (0.235, -0.011) m. A 36 g rigid ground fused-quartz coverslip (32 x 32 x 8 mm optical foot, 62 x 48 x 4 mm upper bezel, and 26 x 26 x 20 mm frosted handling bridge) starts in the front cradle at (0.235, -0.148) m. One fixed starting layout; arms start at ready pose.
scoring: Judged from pure physical end-state geometry with a caliper, ruler, and digital protractor; the run succeeds once 1.0 holds continuously for 3.0 s (60 steps at 20 Hz). Possible scores 0.0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.0. 1.0: the counting chamber stays within 14 mm horizontally and 5 mm vertically of the stage pocket tilted at most 5 deg, both spring stage clips are latched within 19 deg over the outer shoulders, the quartz coverslip rests within 18 mm horizontally and 5 mm vertically of the 10 mm central support rails tilted at most 6 deg, and both grippers are more than 120 mm clear of the chamber, handling grip, stage clips, and coverslip. 0.75: chamber seated, both clips latched, and coverslip flat on the central rails, gripper within 120 mm. 0.50: chamber seated within 14 mm and both stage clips latched within 19 deg, coverslip not yet flat on the central rails. 0.25: chamber seated in the pocket without both stage clips latched. 0.0: otherwise (doing nothing or chamber outside 14 mm).
reset_notes: Lift the 36 g quartz coverslip back to the front staging cradle at (0.235, -0.148) m, retract both brass clip detent carriages toward -Y so both chrome stage clips spring open to 52 deg, and slide the 68 g counting chamber back to the loading shelf at (0.235, -0.011) m.
fidelity: Rigid-body simulation (20 Hz control). Stage clip retention uses two 32 g horizontal-hinge chrome clips (0.045 N m/rad opening springs) engaging separate 28 g sprung brass detent plungers (45 N/m, 18 deg cam ramps) behind the 68 g chamber's outer shoulders against a 28 g, 95 N/m front datum plunger; the fused-quartz coverslip is modelled as a 36 g stepped optical block with a 26 mm frosted handling bridge.
